# Bind the repaired driver for a fresh Windows observation

Prepare a fresh `_scratch/windows-interrupted-owner-native-proposal02` for run label `windows-interrupted-owner-retirement02`. Native01 remains failed at `7f142e8`. The repair's fake qualifications, admitted at `7316e53`, now pass: author `c3d9f3` and independent `01d8d4` each return zero with 30 passing cases and 62 passing subtests, no failures or skips. Root `50475b` verifies identical complete case objects, 36 child hashes, all ten guards, unchanged inputs and exact output membership. Do not repeat those qualifications for this preparation.

Start from the frozen native01 bootstrap, launcher, source map, protocol and false template. Keep all 29 native source names and nine support identities. Replace only the generated adapter source binding with the qualified derivative `_scratch/interrupted-owner-prelock-repair03/generated_adapter_flow.py`, SHA-256 `24844bf419e4d34adaf0d5c5a2678de33a4796de86dad0f83b7e386f1785f961`. Keep the other two repaired core modules and all remaining source bytes. Copy support records as metadata only; do not inspect installed support.

The bootstrap may change only its fixed run-directory label. The launcher may change only the proposal/run labels, its own filename and exact source/control/admission bindings. Preserve every receipt predicate, including ten ordered write observations, five earlier error-32 refusals, five successful opens writing zero bytes, actual primary exit 1, contender/controller exit 0, the fifteen attributed native events, revoked old authority and five confirmed journal phases. Preserve all budgets, guard declarations, fallback/error handling, output bounds and the physical journal decoder. Do not infer a fixed total parent API count from native01.

Deliver exact before/after texts, mechanical diffs, a 29-source map, complete preparation pins, false admission template and short protocol. Prove the bootstrap/launcher differences are only those permitted substitutions, and the driver differs from native01 by the qualified two-line insertion. Keep the original failed run, old proposal and all original assertions intact. A new metadata or script defect found during preparation must be documented; it is not permission to alter behavior expectations.

This is source preparation only. It authorizes no Python startup, candidate execution, native call, fixture/journal creation, support/model/checkpoint/converted-output access, fetch or actual admission. Root owns later full-delta review and a separate exact native admission after preparation. The original native01 observations cannot fill any missing result for native02. D1/D2 stay complete; D3/D4, production migration, full-tree, package, installation and market acceptance remain separate.
# Prepare one generated Windows interrupted-owner observation

Prepare source and controls only in fresh `_scratch/windows-interrupted-owner-native-proposal01`. No native or support access, Python startup, candidate import, compilation, test, generated fixture/journal creation or process launch is admitted by this brief. Root owns later review and execution. The fake28 runs admitted at `e2801a5` passed28/0/0 plus57 subtests in both copies; root9cdc98 verifies identical cases and35 child hashes. Do not repeat them for preparation.

Read the planning brief and SOURCE-MAP.json under `_scratch/interrupted-owner-native-plan01`; their hashes are respectively `57cd25e213cd7ae6a50d76303c35ad39824895f27397af0afeaaf4940d1eb7a7` and `8d01800a43bfd84b9af8d204f8a86bc415b83bbee4ec3536a643f9660e41659c`. Read the complete selected bootstrap/launcher and relevant fixed guard boundaries before editing derivatives. Use the29 mapped source names:25 unchanged native texts, three frozen repair02 core replacements and a new bootstrap. Copy the nine support identities as metadata only. The final32 source/control pairs require fresh exact hashes and a false admission template; actual ROOT-ADMISSION remains absent.

Bind fresh run label `windows-interrupted-owner-retirement01`, positive adoption and drain mode. Keep `child_runtime_owner_flow`, verified DLL dispatch, closed content/import/metadata/registry guards, API accounting and pending-I/O finalizers. After journal/contender binding, construct and bind `_InterruptedOperationProbe`, select `controller_interrupted_recovery_flow`, then `complete_interrupted_recovery`. Select the distinct `before_interrupted_close` observer. Preserve all old controllers, bootstrap/launcher files and their assertions. If bootstrap fallback quarantine fails, retain the original exception and record the secondary failure without suppressing the bounded failure receipt.

The new verifier has a different process outcome contract from cancellation. One segment reaches the caller; two authenticated segment exchanges complete before the fixed Python interruption. Four actions are admit, begin, next, next. There is no cancel or EOF request. The primary job is terminated once through its existing latch, so require retained primary process exit1 and an empty job before individual handle retirement. The contender still refuses journal opening with error32, exits0 and has an empty job. Preserve two creates/resumes, five locked and five post-retirement write probes, manifest/ack/policy checks and restored parent adapter state.

A killed child's final JSON, Python-finally cleanup, final guard result and clean runtime-owner/read-set retirement may be absent. Do not require, synthesize or claim them. Record any available child receipt verbatim as partial; the two authenticated replies establish only their executed path, not final child state. Require complete controller/contender receipts with original12 metadata traps,25 registry traps,33 fixed API bindings, unchanged source hashes, no denials and no pending parent I/O. Do not weaken these requirements because the primary child is terminated.

Require five ordered confirmed journal phases/flushes: INITIALIZED, RESERVED, WORKER_BOUND, QUARANTINED, CLEARED. Bind the exact four-frame prefix hash and post-quarantine head/revision, fifth predecessor, close milestone and released manager record. Keep exclusive bounded postexit journal comparison. Do not guess final journal size or API count. Preserve revocation of old facade/stream/owner/token and aggregate quarantine history.

The new core reports `parent_guards_held_through_exit=False`. Retain that field verbatim and explicitly label it as unavailable for the old ordinary-retirement claim. The new verifier must derive only its distinct process-before-close conclusion from the retained witness, exact handles and native dispatch/closure ordering. Do not change the core field to True, reinterpret False as success for the old assertion, or change the qualified source just to satisfy a wrapper. Report a concrete evidence gap if those existing observations cannot support the new conclusion.

Keep the original16,384-call/60-second cooperative work window and64-call/10-second cleanup reserve. Process/job queries, ordinary handle retirement and journal flushes must fit the existing work window; do not broaden cleanup authority. No new native API, loader route or generated input is requested.

Deliver complete derivative bootstrap and launcher, exact mechanical deltas, source/control map, false template, short protocol and actual read-coverage record. Preserve each draft correction and reason. No candidate execution, admission or successful observation may be claimed. Keep D1/D2 artifacts untouched; D3/D4, real models/PCM/filter loading, controller crash/restart, power loss, live index/5179, paid API, installation, website and marketing outside this unit.
